title: Diene generated runner host egress policy v1
description: The allowlist a lane generates before any substrate mutation and hands to the runner-owned host-policy interface. It is an allowlist, never a denylist of named systems: DNS and the default route are denied outright, so literal-IP and alternate-DNS reachability of an unlisted system fails by construction rather than by naming it.

mode.description: hermetic denies DNS and every route the isolation receipt does not name; connected additionally carries the exact seed and registry routes the connected Ditto lanes require.

items.description: A CIDR or an exact host:port. Wildcards and bare hostnames are not expressible.
